description: This file defines the PaymentService interface, which declares methods related to payment processing, configuration, and validation within the e-commerce system.

classes.name: PaymentService
classes.description: An interface that defines the contract for payment-related operations such as processing payments, refunds, configuration management, and validation in the system.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available payment methods, possibly filtered by merchant store, throwing ServiceException upon failure.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Returns a map of configured payment modules for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes a payment for a customer, given their details, store, payment info, cart items, and order, returning a transaction object.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for an order, given customer, store, and amount, returning a transaction object.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module by payment type, e.g., CREDITCARD or MONEYORDER.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module by its code (e.g., 'paypal').

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves or updates the configuration for a specific payment module.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates the provided credit card number, type, expiration month, and date, throwing ServiceException if invalid.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a specific payment module based on its code and store.

methods.name: removePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes the configuration for a specified payment module.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Completes a payment capture for an order, customer, and store, returning a transaction.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of accepted payment methods for a merchant store.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Retrieves a PaymentModule by its code.
